field_descriptions.comment_time: The time at which the UserComment was made.
field_descriptions.creator: The creator/author of this CreativeWork. This is the same as the Author property for CreativeWork.
field_descriptions.discusses: Specifies the CreativeWork associated with the UserComment.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.reply_to_url: The URL at which a reply may be posted to the specified UserComment.
